title: Effective coding from serialization
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $\mathrm{Code}$ be a type, and assign to each $M\in\mathrm{Code}$ a natural number of states minus one and a $k$-work-tape machine over Boolean symbols with that state set. Suppose a serialization of each code equals the fixed serialization of its assigned machine, and a decoder maps every Boolean word to a code. If a finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine computes the serialization of the decoded code in time bounded by $T$, then these data determine an effective coding scheme for $k$-work-tape machines: each word decodes to its assigned machine, and the same machine computes that machine’s fixed serialization within time $T$.
